laws.name: THE SELF-RECOGNITION FLOOR

laws.name: THE NOISE FLOOR
laws.statement: Noise is never prepared, never founds an entity, and a brief never obliges the misaddressed.

laws.name: THE STAGING LAW
laws.statement: Only the item's own pool material or a same-entity file auto-stages; evidence is quoted and code-checked; a global hit becomes a named suggestion in the ask, never a staged attachment.

laws.name: THE ASK-DIRECTION FLOOR
aliases: OUR ASK IS NEVER THE COUNTERPARTY'S DEBT
laws.statement: Our ask to the user is never the counterparty's debt; the engine ask accepts a typed value or a go-ahead through one door and re-runs the engine.

laws.name: THE ALREADY-BOOKED FLOOR
laws.statement: An invite whose attendee already has a calendar event within ±12h prepares nothing and strips the unsent duplicate; a stated day without a time earns a proposed time inside every stated constraint.

laws.name: THE DEIXIS LAW
aliases: NO DECAYING DAY-WORDS IN STORED TEXT
laws.statement: Stored text never carries decaying day-words — extraction resolves them absolute against the source's own date, and state prose bans them.

laws.name: THE WATERMARK LAW
laws.statement: Every judge sees where the thread stands NOW — the sender's own words with quotes stripped — and an unverifiable count is passed unknown, never a confident zero.

laws.name: FAILURE HONESTY
aliases: A FAILURE IS NEVER A VERDICT
laws.statement: An AI outage is marked and never cached, never resolves, strips or prepares; an empty completion retries once then throws; a null result is spoken, never silent.

laws.name: THE HONESTY FLOOR AT THE ANSWER DOOR
aliases: NO DENIAL WITHOUT A REGISTRY CHECK
laws.statement: No denial leaves the agent loop without a registry check, and the registry pointer fires only when the denial sentence itself names a registry entity.

laws.name: THE VERDICT MOVES THE POSTURE

laws.name: CORRECTIONS STICK

laws.name: THE DENSITY LAW

laws.name: THE NOTICE LAW

laws.name: PRECEDENCE CHAIN, NEVER AN AND

laws.name: LABEL TRUTH

laws.name: SYNC SINGLE-FLIGHT

laws.name: THE SYNC CORRECTNESS INVARIANTS
aliases: NEVER ADVANCE A DELIVERY CURSOR BEFORE ITS WORK IS COMMITTED
ONLY A FULL-WINDOW SYNC ADVANCES last_sync
A STORED EMAIL ALWAYS YIELDS ITS INBOX ITEM

laws.name: AUTHORED, NOT FILED (THE AUTHORSHIP LAW)
aliases: is_from_user = THE AUTHOR IS THE USER

laws.statement: `emails.is_from_user` means the message's AUTHOR is the user — never the folder it sits in. laws.name: EVIDENCE FROM EVERYWHERE
laws.statement: Evidence sources are ROWS (lib/evidence/sources.ts: mail · calendar · transcripts · the commit-door ledger), each emitting ONE normalized EvidenceEvent {source, deed, actor, participants, objects}; adding a tool is one row + one adapter, never a matcher, judge or UI edit, and a row is gated on its DATA existing — a workspace feature gates a row only when it means the source is not collected (email off), never a UI module (the user's synced calendar and stored recordings are evidence whatever modules are shown). The ONE matcher keys on person identity (every address alias + the person id of the resolved counterparty) and object links (same thread / calendar event / house ref / entity membership), never on keywords or name similarity against free text; a bare-name meeting counterparty resolves only through that meeting's own attendee list. WHO acted comes from ONE actor ladder (user > counterparty > teammate > unknown; a public mail domain is never a team domain). A teammate's delivery on work the user owes is nominated, judged by the same fulfillment judge with the actor stated, stamped evidence:teammate and narrated with who did it; cancelled events and declined attendees never count. Every door sees the same evidence: the sync fires the reverse door for mail the user authored AND mail a teammate sent (one helper — W9.2: one sync call site for inbound mail, one in the authored-landed handler for the user's own mail whichever path stored it, both awaited); a deed recorded at the commit door settles its matching work at once (after()); the item judge and the room grounding match with SETTLE_MATCH and state a teammate's deed as theirs.

laws.name: PROJECTS FOLLOW THE MAIL
laws.statement: When recognition links a NEW member (mail, commitment, calendar event, meeting transcript) to an entity, ONE sig-gated refresh of that entity's state is SCHEDULED — coalesced per entity per window (5 min), claimed exactly-once-ish through an item_plans `entity_refresh` marker (insert, or compare-and-set on the read `at`), budgeted (a per-call run cap + a start deadline); whatever a call does not run is marked DIRTY and drained by the next sync tail, reported, never floated as a bare void. Recognition does not wait for a Home load: a user with no initiative memory is bootstrapped from the email-sync tail (bootstrapMemory — chunked, idempotent, budgeted, per-process single-flight + cool-down, the remainder reported). Every calendar sync (hourly cron, push webhooks, manual) recognizes the events it upserted, bounded and reported; the calendar path only MARKS its entities for refresh (never pays a synthesis).

laws.name: JUDGMENTS FOLLOW WHAT MATTERS
aliases: THE DEAL BLOCK IS THE ENTITY DEP
laws.statement: The item judgment's cache sig keys on the entity fields the judge prompt ACTUALLY READS — the rendered deal block (name · state summary · next move · goals · rules, dealBlockOf) — never on the entity's own sig: a re-synthesis that changes nothing the judge reads re-judges nothing. Every cached verdict carries a MaterialStamp (newest inbound on the thread · the item's own deadline passed · the deal's next move); on a re-judgment a newer inbound, a deadline passing, or a changed/cleared next move is NAMED to the judge as a material change (beside new LATER EVIDENCE), while an unchanged present keeps the 'BE CONSISTENT' clause byte-identical and an unstamped prior is never guessed material.

laws.name: THE USER'S HAND WINS
aliases: DRAFTS CHANGE ONLY WHEN THE GROUND MOVES
laws.statement: A prepared artifact is regenerated only when its ground moved (a newer inbound than prepared_from, thread activity past it, supply after it), its drafting law aged, or THE ONE READER withdrew it — never on a clock; and an artifact the user edited (stamped edited_by_user_at + a content hash at the ONE edit door) is never overwritten by the engine: a moved ground only MARKS it (staleUnderEdit, still live) and the user picks a fresh version, which files their words into the version chain first.

gates.note: E2E through the real edit door + THE ONE READER over an in-memory table fake (C6–C10); the 32-combination decision table; every lane's hand + decision wiring; census classifiers; W9.1b section E: a verdict that changes kind / a resolution / the pool's re-run dedupe FILES a hand-held artifact on every lane (E2–E8, E2E through applyVerdictConsequences + writeDeliverable), fail-closed filing (E7), no bare engine strip left in lib/** and every strip site routed (E11–E12)

collides_with.precedence: the ground law decides WHEN machine words are superseded; the user's hand decides WHAT the engine may do about it — a moved ground under a hand-held artifact MARKS it (staleUnderEdit, live), it never supersedes or replaces it; machine words keep the ground law unchanged

a stale-under-edit artifact still renders (the card serves the user's words with the mark), so its claim stands; the engine never generates an unrendered 'fresh alternative' — a fresh version exists only when the user asks for one
the hand and staleUnderEdit are derived at THE ONE READER; the edit door writes the artifact's one home in place — no mirror row, no second reader
